text: make a website for our college tech fest called Spark 2026 at Northfield College of Engineering in Pune. students should be able to see the schedule day by day, browse events by category, register for an event with a form, see the sponsors, find the venue, and contact the organisers on whatsapp. it should feel energetic and modern and work well on phones

@Requester Thanks, this is a great start. I need a few details that only you know before we begin.
Please send these: What are the fest dates, and can you list the events? For each one, please give the name, day, time and category (for example coding, robotics, gaming).; What WhatsApp number should students use to reach the organisers (with country code), and is there a message you want pre-filled when they tap it; Where exactly is the venue? Please give the full address and the building or ground on campus where events happen.; Who are the sponsors (names, and logos if you have them), and what should happen when a student submits the sign-up form.
Paused: Identity is waiting on the Requester (J2.a: not enough information to work yet). Site v0 is in the preview. Answer Identity's question above to continue.

Dates: 14 to 16 February 2027. Venue: Northfield College of Engineering, 22 University Road, Pune 411007. Organisers on WhatsApp: +91 00000 33333. Email: spark2026@example.com. Events: Coding: Code Sprint (day 1, 10am to 1pm, Rs 100); Bug Hunt (day 2, 11am to 1pm, Rs 50). Robotics: Line Follower (day 1, 2pm to 5pm, Rs 150); Drone Dash (day 3, 10am to 1pm, Rs 200). Design: Poster Jam (day 2, 2pm to 4pm, free); UI Duel (day 3, 2pm to 5pm, Rs 100). Talks: AI in Daily Life (day 1, 5:30pm to 6:30pm, free); Startup Stories (day 3, 5:30pm to 6:30pm, free). Registration form fields: name, email, college, event (dropdown); submitting sends an email to spark2026@example.com. Sponsors: Nimbus Cloud, Orbit Labs, Pixel Press (names only, no logos). No photos yet, use placeholders.
@Requester Thanks, I have what I need. The team is starting to build your site now, using the dates, events, contact details and sponsors you sent.

@Adaptation Propose workflows for the Spark 2026 site per the charter. Use only the facts the Requester supplied (8 events, 3 days, 4 categories, 3 sponsors, WhatsApp +91 00000 33333, spark2026@example.com, venue address). Use clearly marked placeholders for photos. Do not invent a building or ground name, or any pre-filled WhatsApp message text.
@Adaptation Charter valid: statement present, 11 checkable done-when items. Work can start.

@Priority Eight small workflows, one per site section, covering all 11 items. Registration uses a mailto link because a one-file site cannot send email on its own. It opens the student's mail app with the details filled in, and a real send needs a form service, which is a Requester decision.
